integrity: The full analytical theorem and its hypotheses are in RESULT.md; verify.py independently recomputes the original reduced vector field, thresholds, equilibrium residuals, and two-dimensional Jacobian via finite differences. No external independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Local linear/exponential stability in the two-dimensional counterfactual-learning differential equation only; boundary cases with zero transverse eigenvalue, full four-dimensional frequency-weighted learning, agent-based simulations, and global basins are not characterized. Supplemental publisher PDF was inaccessible; possible equivalent prior results remain a residual originality risk.
title: Reentrant attraction of segregated platform equilibria near indifference
